title: Open the project inquiry modal from the hero CTA
description: A visitor can open the project-start modal from the homepage hero and see the inquiry experience appear.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the main value proposition is visible
Click the primary call to action to start a project
Verify the project inquiry modal is displayed

title: Scroll through all landing page content sections
description: A visitor can explore the landing page from services through pricing and see the core marketing sections load correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page to the services section
Scroll down the page to the portfolio section
Scroll down the page to the testimonials section
Scroll down the page to the pricing section
Verify the services section is visible
Verify the portfolio, testimonials, and pricing sections are visible

title: Open the project inquiry modal after exploring the page
description: A visitor can scroll through the landing page content and still launch the project-start modal from the CTA.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page to the portfolio section
Scroll down the page to the testimonials section
Click the call to action to start a project
Verify the project inquiry modal is displayed
Verify the landing page remains accessible behind the modal

title: Review portfolio and testimonials before starting a project
description: A visitor can inspect showcase content and then open the project-start modal from the page CTA.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page to the portfolio section
Scroll down the page to the testimonials section
Click the call to action to start a project
Verify the portfolio and testimonials sections are visible
Verify the project inquiry modal is displayed

title: Close the project inquiry modal
description: A visitor can open the project-start modal and dismiss it without leaving the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary call to action to start a project
Close the project inquiry modal
Verify the landing page is visible
Verify the project inquiry modal is no longer displayed

title: Reopen the project inquiry modal after closing it
description: A visitor can dismiss the modal and open it again from the landing page without breaking page state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary call to action to start a project
Close the project inquiry modal
Click the primary call to action to start a project again
Verify the project inquiry modal is displayed
Verify the landing page is still available

title: Complete the project inquiry form
description: A visitor can enter project details in the modal and keep the submitted information visible before closing it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary call to action to start a project
Fill in the project details field with a short project summary
Fill in the contact details field with a valid contact value
Verify the project inquiry form reflects the entered details
Verify the modal remains open with the completed form

title: Experience cinematic animations while browsing the page
description: A visitor can continue reading the landing page while motion and 3D visual effects appear as sections come into view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll down the page slowly through multiple sections
Verify animated section transitions are displayed
Verify the page content remains readable while scrolling

title: Handle empty project details in the modal
description: A visitor can open the project-start modal and see validation feedback when required details are left empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the primary call to action to start a project
Submit the project inquiry form without entering details
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the project inquiry modal stays open

title: Use the landing page on a fast scroll
description: A visitor can rapidly move through the landing page and still reach the main content sections without losing the page layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll quickly to the lower sections of the page
Verify the lower content sections are visible
Verify the page layout remains usable
